title: Pachanga Basics Tutorial for Beginners + Practice Routine

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor is enthusiastic, encouraging, and structures her tutorial logically. She breaks down the foundational bounce and footwork step-by-step before adding music.

lesson_structure.note: Tara the Dance Doctor introduces the pachanga basics tutorial.
Tara mentions her online courses and 3-day free trial.
Explains pachanga timing and the underlying bounce using salsa counts.
Practices the bounce from the back angle without music.
Practices the bounce and body movement with music playing.
Introduces footwork, adding backward steps on count eight.

metaphors: pulling the rug out from under the other foot
common_mistakes: having two heels on the ground at the same time
safety: try not to ever have two heels on the ground at a time

steps_taught.name: Pachanga bounce and basic footwork
steps_taught.description: Hinging action in hips and knees with alternating back foot touches on eight.

what_works: Clear breakdown of timing and bounce before introducing steps
Repetition of counts and movements from different angles
what_hinders: Footstep sounds or music sometimes obscure spoken cues

quotes.text: I'm Tara, the Dance Doctor, welcome to my channel.
If we're dancing salsa and we're going one, two, three, five, six, seven.
When we're dancing pachanga, we want to try not to ever have two heels on the ground at a time.
